details.description: Pitambari Shining Powder is used to polish metals, namely copper, brass, aluminium, iron, silver, and steel. This powder is a must-have in every house as it will help keep items like decorative objects, antiques, and musical instruments looking new and polished. It removes the oxide layer easily from metal surfaces. Its diamond edge-cutting property gives a fast cleaning effect. No more scrubbing, no mess, no waste, easy to apply. It is effective on copper, brass, aluminium, steel, iron, silver, and other utensils. It cleans, protects, preserves, and restores the shine and lustre to a variety of different surfaces.

Pitambari Rooperi Silver Shine is an advanced cleaning product specially designed to restore the shine and brilliance of silver utensils, jewellery and other silver items. This unique formula effectively removes tarnish, stains and dullness, leaving your silver possessions sparkling like new with minimal effort. The powerful yet gentle formula works quickly to bring out the original lustre, while ensuring your silver items retain their luster without any damage or scratching. Whether you're cleaning silverware, coins or heirloom silver jewellery, this versatile cleaner is ideal for achieving a polished, elegant finish. With regular use, you can keep your silver pieces looking their absolute best, adding a touch of sophistication to your home or collection. The user-friendly application makes it a must-have for anyone looking to maintain the beauty of their silver articles.

Elevate your sacred rituals and ceremonies with Deep Shakti, a premium lamp oil crafted with the nourishing goodness of sesame oil. Designed to provide a sootless, smokeless, and consistent wick burn, this oil will bring a sense of peace and tranquility to your home. Infused with the calming aroma of lavender, lighting your diyas and lamps with Deep Shakti will not only create a serene ambiance, but also invite wealth, happiness, health, and luck into your life. Suitable for use in traditional oil lamps, this high-quality lamp oil is a must-have for those auspicious and ceremonial occasions.

Pitambari Thicker Dishwash Liquid, enriched with natural lemongrass oil, boasts antibacterial properties and a refreshing lime scent. Its superior viscosity makes it particularly effective for non-stick cookware and crockery, ensuring a spotless, scratch-free shine. This dishwash liquid also functions efficiently in hard water, retaining its cleaning potency.
The Pitambari Dishwash Liquid not only cleans but also deodorises your cookware, leaving them looking pristine and smelling fresh after every wash. Opt for Pitambari for a thorough, gentle clean that respects your dishes and the environment.

Pitambari dishwash liquid ensures scratch-free and stain-free cleaning, and is ideal for cleaning glass, stainless steel, melamine, and non-stick ware. It contains unique surfactants that efficiently eliminate food stains, leaving a pleasant lemon aroma that makes utensils look and smell squeaky clean.
